currentFocus: Preparing the October 27 Soft Alpha: chat, Whispers, moderation, trading, and recipe-unlock notices are in; polishing Chat/Social with @mentions, blocked-player placeholders, and Whisper Hide.

currentChange.summary: Chat/Social polish: @mention players in General and Trade, blocked players' messages become placeholders instead of gaps, and Whisper conversations can be hidden.

latestCompleted.summary: Recipe-unlock notices: reaching a Refining or Fabrication level that unlocks recipes sends one grouped, read-only System message, pinned in Chat/Social Whispers.

nextStep: Human preview and playtest of Chat/Social polish with two accounts: @mention someone in General or Trade, block a talkative player, and hide a Whisper (#261).

highlights.summary: Deep Jag is playable: brace the cave-in for Tansy, mine Galvanite behind it, and refine Galvanic Stock and Galvaferrite at the Processing Yard.
Added Rusk Recovery and 10,000 Hours: Wade's own yard, a workbench that practises Welding indefinitely for scrap, and the Clean Pass moment every weld now rolls.
Added Map MISSION and TURN IN destinations, blue turn-in guidance, compact Mission strips at the top of Play, and visible keyboard focus on beveled controls.
